title: Capture OpenRouter Qwen's reasoning correctly: labelled by provider, words only on whole lines, provider and source class on every record, effort asked
request: Step 2 of the approved plan to move every DCLab model call from Claude to OpenRouter qwen/qwen3.8-flash: label kept reasoning by provider, fix shape-only lines keeping raw reasoning, add provider and source_class to every exchange line and usage row from the endpoint host, send OpenRouter a reasoning effort from DCLAB_THINKING_EFFORT with one fallback to enabled.
plan: Read the gateway's exchange keeper, its usage row and the OpenAI-style client's request and reply parsing.
Label the thinking text by who returned it and move raw reasoning into the whole branch and the sealed vault copy.
Derive provider and source_class from the tier's endpoint host; write them on exchange lines and usage rows (file and PostgreSQL, migration 0023).
Send reasoning.effort on OpenRouter (xhigh and max become high), keep the off-switches, retry once with enabled on an effort refusal and learn it per model.
Test with scripted transports only, run the related files on files and PostgreSQL and make agent-eval, then an adversarial review.

decisions.decision: Provider comes from the endpoint host: anthropic, openrouter, openai, openai_compatible, local or unknown.
decisions.why: A model name can be served by several hosts; the host says who returned the words. openai_compatible keeps another hosted endpoint (Hugging Face router) apart from OpenAI itself.

decisions.decision: On OpenRouter the source class follows the model's vendor: named open families (Qwen by the owner's 2026-11-11 decision, Llama, DeepSeek, Gemma, Phi, gpt-oss...) are open_weights_model, closed vendors commercial_model, any other unknown.
decisions.why: The host alone would file Claude or a hosted-only model served through OpenRouter as open-weights output in the training sets (reviewer finding).

decisions.decision: A summary relayed by OpenRouter is labelled 'API thinking summary (via OpenRouter)'.
decisions.why: The owner's rule: a summary is called a summary. A closed model's reasoning through OpenRouter, or one marked reasoning.summary, is not raw.

decisions.decision: Raw reasoning and reasoning_details only on whole lines and the sealed vault copy; shape-only keeps thinking_redacted.
decisions.why: Before, both were written before the whole/shape-only branch, so a purpose shown cell values or a sealed exam kept the model's raw words.

decisions.decision: The usage row takes its source from the bound tier that served, not the configured one.
decisions.why: A fixed tier or a model override can differ from the configured tier; the first test caught the row saying openai for an OpenRouter call.

decisions.decision: Add model_request.provider and source_class with migration 0023 rather than keeping them on the file log only.
decisions.why: The file and PostgreSQL usage logs share one field list (usage.FIELDS, storage/migrate.py copies it); one backend without them would make the training rules differ by backend.

change: gateway.py: THINKING_LABELS, source_of, thinking_label, _source_of_tier; _keep_exchange writes provider, source_class, the label, reasoning_asked and keeps raw reasoning only where words are kept; Gateway.record takes a source. client.py: openrouter_effort, EFFORT_REFUSED, _refuses_effort, _reasoning_sent; _extra sends an effort; _create retries once on an effort refusal; the single-attempt path learns the refusal without retrying. usage.py FIELDS, storage/models.py and migration 0023 gain provider and source_class. Tests: tests/test_openrouter_reasoning_capture.py (12), tests/test_task_decomposer.py given Claude's host.

findings.defect: Shape-only exchange lines kept raw reasoning and reasoning_details.
findings.scenario: A purpose shown cell values, a workspace keeping no model text or a sealed exam served by OpenRouter wrote the model's raw reasoning beside the shape.
findings.cause: The two keys were added to the line before the whole/shape-only branch.
findings.fix: Moved into the whole branch and the vault copy; shape-only keeps thinking_redacted.

findings.defect: The usage row named the configured tier's provider, not the one that served.
findings.scenario: A bound OpenRouter tier while settings resolved to OpenAI wrote provider openai, commercial_model.
findings.cause: Gateway.record reads settings.public(tier), the configured tier.

findings.defect: test_task_decomposer asserted 'API thinking summary' for a scripted Claude model on no Claude host.
findings.scenario: run_parallel blanks the provider settings, so the tier had no Anthropic host and the label became the generic one.
findings.cause: The label now follows the host; the test claimed Claude without its host.
findings.fix: The test's tier names Claude's host (OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.anthropic.com/v1).

findings.defect: A closed model's summary relayed by OpenRouter was labelled raw reasoning.
findings.scenario: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 through OpenRouter returns summarized thinking; the line said 'raw, as returned by OpenRouter'.
findings.cause: The label was chosen by provider only.
findings.fix: thinking_label: a commercial model on OpenRouter, or only reasoning.summary items, is 'API thinking summary (via OpenRouter)'.

findings.defect: Any OpenRouter model not on the closed list was filed as open weights.
findings.scenario: mistralai/mistral-medium or a hosted-only model would enter training sets as open-weights output.
findings.fix: Named open families only; any other OpenRouter model is unknown.

findings.defect: A single-attempt request never learned a refused effort.
findings.scenario: The task decomposer (single attempt) would fail on every call if Qwen refused the effort.
findings.fix: It adds the model to EFFORT_REFUSED and raises, so the next request sends enabled; still one attempt.

findings.defect: The effort fallback fired on any 400 mentioning 'reasoning'.
findings.scenario: A 400 'reasoning_details must be an array' in an agent loop was retried and dropped the effort for the rest of the process.
findings.cause: The check matched 'reasoning' as well as 'effort'.
findings.fix: Only a 400/422 naming the effort counts.

measurements.name: Related test files, file backend
measurements.gate: Gateway, client, thinking capture, store readers, exam vault and task decomposer tests pass with no live model.
measurements.result: 212 tests in 14 files pass (1 skipped: agentic needs another environment).
limits: Scripted transports: no real OpenRouter reply shape is measured here; the plan's live check (make model-paths) does that.

measurements.name: PostgreSQL
measurements.gate: Migration 0023 applies and the storage tests pass on dclab_test.
measurements.result: Schema at 0023; 108 tests in 7 files pass on PostgreSQL.
limits: dclab_dev and any deployed database need 'python -m dclab_rnd.storage upgrade' before their usage rows are written.

measurements.name: make agent-eval
limits: Scripted policies on planted traps, not a model's quality.

outcome: Step 2 built and reviewed: the reviewer's five findings fixed with tests. Not committed (other steps edit the same tree); not yet checked against a live OpenRouter reply.
lessons: Write words into a record only inside the branch that decides whether words may be kept.
Name who served a request from the tier that served it, not from the configured tier.
A source class for training must fail closed: unknown, never open weights by default.
A fallback keyed on a provider's error words must name the exact thing refused.
risks: Whether qwen/qwen3.8-flash has public weights is not checked here; it is filed open_weights_model by the owner's decision, and its licence is checked before any fine-tune.
OpenRouter's reasoning_details types (reasoning.text, reasoning.summary, reasoning.encrypted) are read as documented; a live reply should confirm Qwen sends reasoning.text.
A PostgreSQL database not upgraded to 0023 loses usage rows silently (Gateway.record swallows the insert error), as with earlier column migrations.
